info.name: NexusMarket API
info.description:
All NexusMarket endpoints grouped by role.

1. Run one of the login requests in '0. Public'. The token is saved automatically.
2. Run the requests of that role. Identifiers (productId, orderId, shipmentId, returnId, refundId, inventoryId, warehouseId) are saved automatically by the requests that create them.
3. To act as another role, run that role's login.

Seed users: admin/admin123, operador/operador123, supervisor/supervisor123, tecnostore/vendedor123, ana/comprador123.
